title: Claude Code power user customization: How to configure hooks
tldr: This post details how to implement and configure "hooks" within Claude Code for power users, enabling custom logic execution at specific points in the coding workflow. It provides guidance on extending the default behavior of Claude Code through programmatic integration points.

title: Using CLAUDE.md files: Customizing Claude Code for your codebase
tldr: This article introduces the concept and practical application of `CLAUDE.md` files, enabling developers to customize Claude Code's behavior and context for specific codebases. It details how these configuration files allow fine-grained control over the AI agent's understanding and interaction with a project.

title: How to create Skills: Key steps, limitations, and examples
tldr: This guide provides a technical overview of creating "Skills" for the Claude platform, outlining the necessary steps, potential limitations, and practical examples for developers. It explains how to programmatically define new capabilities that extend Claude's core functionalities.

title: Structured outputs on the Claude Developer Platform
tldr: This post announces and details the availability of structured output capabilities on the Claude Developer Platform, enabling developers to reliably extract data in specified formats like JSON or XML. It discusses the underlying mechanisms and best practices for leveraging this feature to integrate LLM outputs into downstream systems.

title: Skills explained: How Skills compares to prompts, Projects, MCP, and subagents
tldr: This article provides a detailed comparison of "Skills" within the Claude ecosystem, contrasting them with existing paradigms like prompts, Projects, Meta-Cognitive Processes (MCP), and subagents. It elucidates the architectural and functional distinctions, guiding developers on when and how to apply each concept for building complex AI workflows.

title: Migrate MLflow tracking servers to Amazon SageMaker AI with serverless MLflow
tldr: This engineering blog details the process of migrating existing MLflow tracking servers to a serverless architecture on Amazon SageMaker AI. It outlines the technical steps and benefits of leveraging SageMaker's serverless MLflow capabilities for improved scalability and reduced operational overhead in MLOps workflows.
